caption: The drawing depicts a long, full-length dress with long sleeves and a fitted bodice. The dress is primarily a muted mauve or lavender color and features a standing collar and a row of small, closely-spaced golden buttons running down the center front of the bodice. The fabric appears to be gathered slightly at the waist, creating a peplum-like effect at the waistline above the skirt. The skirt is full and has several large, irregularly-shaped dark brown appliqué patches with an intricate, web-like lighter brown or gold vein pattern. These appliqués are located on the chest, sides, front, and lower part of the skirt, as well as on the left wrist area and a square patch hanging from the right hip. The hem of the skirt is decorated with a series of inverted pleats or contrasting dark inserts along the bottom edge. The dress is displayed against a plain, light background and does not show any wearer, mannequin head, or hands.
title: Brown Silk Afternoon Dress
